Today's selection covers 54 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 39 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI Says It Has Cracked One of Math’s ‘Millennium Problems’

• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, BBC Technology, TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
